reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage correctly performs exact need-to-capability matching, preserves the allowed record identifiers, and marks unmatched needs as unsupported. The supplied final coverage matches the declared capabilities: n06-r02/r03/r04/r05/r06/r08 are direct, while n06-r01 and n06-r07 are unsupported.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff needs while mapping capabilities
missing capability should remain visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag: it sets unsupported = coverage == 'direct'. This makes covered needs sort before truly unsupported needs and labels direct coverage rows as unsupported. The final priorities therefore put n06-r02 first and push actual unsupported needs n06-r01 and n06-r07 to priorities 7 and 8, contradicting the boundary role requiring unsupported needs before covered needs.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as primary ordering within each group
preserve market-demand evidence without converting covered alternatives into unsupported demand

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation follows the already-ranked first priority record and retains the explicit eight-item window as declared. Its local logic is consistent, but its recommendation is behaviorally contaminated by the failed upstream priority table from bnd-ec8195a15cc684b4, so it should not be trusted for reporting the final recommendation.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: retain the explicit eight-item priority window
construct recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record
